decision: REJECT count-reuse candidate C: lower stress FPS in all three pairs on both backends despite callback-wall savings. Restore B6 counting. Depth-order prototype also rejected for pixel differences. No accepted production speedup.
aggregation: Median of three independent run means/FPS for case summaries; each row also preserves complete per-run p95/p99/max. FPS=1000/mean RAF interval, not reciprocal of quantized median interval. CPU is callback wall, includes driver/sampler work.
